How it works

Start earning in five simple steps

Every screen below is the partner dashboard you get on day one. The live feed changes every Monday.

Pick an offer from this week's feed

Every Monday we list the offers we funded that week. Some pay 100% of the first paid month, some a flat bounty per paid subscriber, some a few dollars per confirmed signup or completed audit. Each card states the type, the amount and whether the kit is ready. Nothing appears until its bounties are escrowed.

gildium.link/offers

Grab your page, your coupon and the kit

You get your own landing page per offer, such as postsie.com/you, with 10% off already applied, a coupon that gives the same discount at checkout, and a tracked link to your page for each network. The kit has the demo video, screenshots, hooks per network, a free creator account and the disclosure text.

gildium.link/offers/postsie

Post everywhere you publish

A YouTube review, a 30-second TikTok or Reel, a paragraph in your newsletter, a LinkedIn or Threads post, a pinned Discord message. Each network has its own link, so you see which channel converts and can double down there. Your voice, an honest take, disclosure before the link.

gildium.link/links

Watch referrals move from click to renewal

Every referral shows by stage: clicked, signed up, paid month one, renewed. A bounty becomes payable the day the second payment clears, about 35 days after signup. A refund inside that window cancels that bounty and nothing else. You never owe money back.

gildium.link/earnings

Get one payout for every offer, on the 1st

Payable bounties across all offers go out together on the first of the month by Wise or Stripe once they reach $50. Tax form once at signup, PDF statement monthly. Every offer is pre-funded, so if we retire a product inside 12 months, bounties you earned are paid from that escrow.

FAQ

What partners ask first

Why 100% of month one and not a recurring share?

Because a full payment after your first referral is what keeps creators going, and for a new product the first paying month is the number that matters. Offers that are not monthly subscriptions use a flat bounty instead. If you would rather have a recurring split on an offer, say so in the application. We are testing both in the pilot.

How does the $49 sign-up bonus work?

Every new partner has a $49 bonus waiting. It is not paid for signing up; it unlocks when your first bounty becomes payable, which means one subscriber who stayed past their second payment, or one confirmed signup or audit past its 30-day hold. It then goes out in the same transfer as that first bounty.

Why wait for the second renewal?

It covers the refund window without a clawback, filters out signups that were never real, and means we only pay for subscribers who stayed. The hold is about 35 days, in line with the 30 to 90 day holds on most programs.

Does the discount come out of my bounty?

No. The 10% your audience gets is funded by Gildium. Your bounty is 100% of what they actually paid for month one, and the $25 floor applies to that, so on most offers the floor is what you receive.

What happens if Gildium retires a product?

Every offer is pre-funded before you see it. If a product is retired inside 12 months of listing, bounties you already earned are paid from that escrow on the normal schedule. You also get 60 days' notice before any change to the terms.

Can I subscribe through my own link?

No. Self-referrals are cancelled, and because bounties pay after the second renewal there is nothing to gain. Coupon sites, paid ads on a product's name and incentivised signups are out for the same reason.

Do I need to be in the US?

No. We collect a W-9 or W-8BEN once at signup and pay by Wise or Stripe in your currency. EU partners invoice under reverse charge, which the monthly statement handles for you.

Who can join?

  • You cover software, AI tools, productivity, design or small-business topics.
  • You publish on at least one of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Threads, X, LinkedIn, a newsletter, a blog or a Discord you run.
  • You post at least twice a month and have for six months.
  • You disclose, and you are comfortable saying when a product is not for someone.
